theorems.name: Submission.ted_lpm_am_exp_perturbation_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (Λ q u : ℝ), 0 < Λ → 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → |u| ≤ Λ / 4 * q → Real.exp (-Λ) ≤ Real.exp u ∧ Real.exp u ≤ Real.exp Λ ∧ |Real.exp u - 1| ≤ Real.exp (Λ / 2) / 2 * Λ * q ∧ (Λ ≤ 1 → |Real.exp u - 1| ≤ Λ * q)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
